name: bricksurance-data-core
title: Bricksurance Data Core
description: An open, business-first semantic data model for insurance, aligned to ACORD terminology with a crosswalk to the Lloyd's Core Data Record. Platform artifacts are generated from these specs; see bindings/ and tools/.
standards_basis: Aligned to ACORD terminology with a Lloyd's Core Data Record crosswalk. Element names are cited as a crosswalk only; licensed standards are not reproduced.

domains.name: reference
domains.description: Shared code sets and classifications used across all domains, plus the generated data dictionary. Reference data is versioned with the model: allowed values live in the specs, not in anyone's head.

domains.name: org
domains.description: The group's own legal-entity structure - the reporting hierarchy every other domain hangs off. Solvency II, IFRS 17 and statutory accounts all report at solo (subsidiary) and group (consolidated) level; this domain is what makes that distinction real rather than assumed.

domains.name: finance
domains.description: The finance function proper - a real double-entry general ledger (chart of accounts, balanced journals, accounting periods), the operational sub-ledgers (premium, claims, commission, expense, receivables), regulatory and actuarial measures (Solvency II, IFRS 17), financial-statement structure, budget and FX. Everything a CFO org runs on.

domains.name: investment
domains.description: The asset side of the balance sheet - investment holdings, valuations and income. Roughly half an insurer's balance sheet; without it there is no balance sheet and no ALM conversation.

domains.name: party
domains.description: People and organisations, and the roles they play in the business (insured, broker, cedant, reinsurer, claimant). A party exists once; relationships are roles.

domains.name: policy
domains.description: Insurance contracts and their composition - policies, coverages, insured objects and premium transactions.

domains.name: claim
domains.description: Claims against policies and their financial development - reserves, payments and recoveries as transactions, never as overwritten balances.

domains.name: reinsurance
domains.description: Outward and inward reinsurance - treaties, cessions and recoveries linking the direct book to reinsurers.

domains.name: product
domains.description: Machine-readable products - offered coverages, underwriting questions and appetite rules as data, so any channel (human, aggregator or buyer agent) can discover, quote and be decided against the same rules.

domains.name: distribution
domains.description: How business reaches the insurer - channels and intermediary remuneration, transactional and disclosable.

domains.name: conduct
domains.description: Fair treatment made measurable - complaints per FCA groupings, through to ombudsman referral and redress.

domains.name: content
domains.description: Governed unstructured content - wordings, schedules, evidence, slips - with extracted text searchable under the same governance as rows.

domains.name: events
domains.description: The append-only business event stream - the near-real-time face of the model and the feed for monitoring agents.

domains.name: life
domains.description: Life business - grouped model points, governed assumption sets, economic scenario sets and valuation runs. Life policies themselves are ordinary policies with life lines of business.

domains.name: exchange
domains.description: Canonical data-exchange objects (bordereau lines, submissions) and the landing zone for inbound counterparty data before mapping to the canonical model.

domains.name: semantics
domains.description: Business metrics defined once over the canonical model - gross written premium, net earned premium, incurred, loss ratio, combined ratio. Physicalised as metric views where the platform supports them.

codes.label: Liability

codes.label: Expense

codes.label: Corporate Bond

codes.label: Equity

codes.label: Property

codes.label: Cash & Deposits

codes.label: Collective Investment

codes.description: Replaced by a newer approved set; retained for reproducibility.

code_sets.name: assumption_type
code_sets.title: Assumption Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of actuarial assumption governed through the assumption-set maker/checker process.

codes.label: Mortality
codes.description: Mortality rates by age, typically expressed against a standard table.

codes.label: Lapse

codes.label: Expense
codes.description: Per-policy and percentage expense loadings.

codes.label: Economic
codes.description: Economic assumptions such as discount and inflation bases.

code_sets.name: business_event_type

codes.label: Quote Requested
codes.description: A quotation was requested through any channel.

codes.label: Policy Bound
codes.description: Cover was bound.

codes.label: First Notification of Loss
codes.description: A loss was first notified.

codes.label: Claim Payment
codes.description: A claim payment was issued.

codes.label: Complaint Received
codes.description: A complaint was received.

codes.label: Bordereau Received
codes.description: An inbound bordereau arrived for mapping.

codes.label: Fire
codes.description: Fire, including smoke damage and firefighting damage.

codes.label: Flood
codes.description: Inundation from external water, including river and surface water flooding.

codes.label: Storm
codes.description: Windstorm, hail and associated weather damage.

codes.label: Water Damage
codes.description: Escape of water from internal systems such as burst pipes.

codes.label: Theft
codes.description: Theft, attempted theft and malicious damage in connection with it.

codes.label: Collision
codes.description: Impact of a vehicle with another vehicle or object.

codes.label: Liability Incident

code_sets.name: claim_status
code_sets.title: Claim Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle status of a claim. Financial development lives in claim transactions; status describes the handling state only.

codes.label: Open
codes.description: Claim reported and under active handling.

codes.label: Closed
codes.description: Claim settled and closed; reserves released or exhausted.

codes.label: Reopened
codes.description: Previously closed claim reopened for further development.

codes.label: Declined
codes.description: Claim declined as not covered; no indemnity payable.

code_sets.name: claim_transaction_type
code_sets.title: Claim Transaction Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of claim financial movement. Claims finance is transactional: case reserves, payments and recoveries are signed movements, and figures such as outstanding or incurred are always derived by summation.

standards.acord: Claim payment / reserve patterns of the ACORD Information Model

codes.label: Case Reserve Movement
codes.description: Signed change to the case reserve estimate. The current outstanding reserve is the sum of these movements less indemnity payments.

codes.label: Indemnity Payment
codes.description: Payment to the claimant in settlement of the insured loss.

codes.label: Expense Payment
codes.description: Allocated loss adjustment expense, such as legal or surveyor fees.

codes.label: Recovery
codes.description: Amount recovered by subrogation, salvage or contribution; negative from the insurer's cost perspective.

code_sets.name: commission_type
code_sets.title: Commission Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of intermediary remuneration. Commission is transactional - signed movements, never overwritten balances - and disclosable by design.

codes.label: New Business Commission
codes.description: Commission on newly written business.

codes.label: Renewal Commission
codes.description: Commission on renewed business.

codes.label: Profit Commission
codes.description: Contingent commission based on account performance.

codes.label: Clawback
codes.description: Commission returned on cancellation or lapse; negative amount.

code_sets.name: complaint_category
code_sets.title: Complaint Category
code_sets.description: Root category of a customer complaint, aligned to UK FCA complaints reporting groupings.

codes.label: Claims Handling
codes.description: Delay, declinature, settlement amount or communication during a claim.

codes.label: Sales & Advice
codes.description: Mis-sale, unsuitable product or unclear information at the point of sale.

codes.label: Administration & Service
codes.description: Errors, delays or poor service in policy administration.

codes.label: Pricing & Renewal
codes.description: Premium levels, renewal pricing or mid-term charges.

code_sets.name: complaint_status
code_sets.title: Complaint Status
code_sets.description: Handling status of a complaint, through to ombudsman referral.

codes.label: Open
codes.description: Under investigation within the regulatory response window.

codes.label: Upheld
codes.description: Resolved in the complainant's favour; redress may apply.

codes.label: Not Upheld
codes.description: Resolved with the original decision maintained.

codes.label: Referred to FOS
codes.description: Escalated to the Financial Ombudsman Service.

code_sets.name: consent_purpose
code_sets.title: Consent Purpose
code_sets.description: Purposes a data subject can consent to, per the processing register.

codes.label: Marketing
codes.description: Direct marketing communications.

codes.label: Data Sharing
codes.description: Sharing personal data with named partners.

codes.label: Profiling
codes.description: Automated profiling for pricing or service decisions.

code_sets.name: consent_status
code_sets.title: Consent Status
code_sets.description: State of a consent record; withdrawal is an auditable event, not a deletion.

codes.label: Granted
codes.description: Consent currently in force.

codes.label: Withdrawn
codes.description: Consent withdrawn by the data subject.

codes.label: Expired
codes.description: Consent lapsed at its expiry.

code_sets.name: contact_point_type
code_sets.title: Contact Point Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of contact point held for a party.

codes.label: Email
codes.description: Email address.

codes.label: Phone
codes.description: Telephone number.

codes.label: Postal Address
codes.description: Postal address.

code_sets.name: country
code_sets.title: Country
code_sets.description: Countries the group operates or insures risks in, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. A governed subset, extended when the business enters a market.

codes.label: United Kingdom
codes.description: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland.

codes.label: Ireland
codes.description: Republic of Ireland.

codes.label: Germany
codes.description: Federal Republic of Germany.

codes.label: France
codes.description: French Republic.

codes.label: Switzerland
codes.description: Swiss Confederation.

codes.label: United States

code_sets.name: coverage_type
code_sets.title: Coverage Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of cover that can be granted under a policy. A policy bundles one or more coverages; limits, deductibles and claims attach at coverage level.

codes.label: Buildings
codes.description: Physical damage to buildings and fixed structures.

codes.label: Contents
codes.description: Physical damage to contents, stock and equipment.

codes.label: Business Interruption
codes.description: Loss of income and increased cost of working following insured physical damage.

codes.label: Motor Own Damage
codes.description: Damage to the insured vehicle itself.

codes.label: Motor Third-Party Liability
codes.description: Liability to third parties arising from use of the insured vehicle.

codes.label: Public Liability

codes.label: Cargo
codes.description: Loss of or damage to goods in transit.

code_sets.name: csm_movement_type
code_sets.title: CSM Movement Type
code_sets.description: Steps in the IFRS 17 contractual service margin roll-forward. The closing CSM is the signed sum of these movements over the opening balance - a balance derived from movements, never overwritten.

codes.label: Opening Balance
codes.description: CSM brought forward.

codes.label: New Business
codes.description: CSM recognised on contracts added in the period.

codes.label: Interest Accretion
codes.description: Interest accreted on the CSM at locked-in rates.

codes.label: Experience Adjustment
codes.description: Changes in estimates that adjust the CSM.

codes.label: Release to P&L

code_sets.name: currency
code_sets.title: Currency
code_sets.description: Transaction currencies used by the group, as ISO 4217 alphabetic codes. This is deliberately a governed subset, not the full ISO list: a currency is added here when the business starts writing in it.

codes.label: Pound Sterling
codes.description: United Kingdom pound sterling.

codes.label: Euro
codes.description: Euro.

codes.label: US Dollar
codes.description: United States dollar.

codes.label: Swiss Franc
codes.description: Swiss franc.

code_sets.name: distribution_channel
code_sets.title: Distribution Channel
code_sets.description: How business reaches the insurer. Machine channels are first-class: an agentic buyer is a channel, not an exception.

codes.label: Direct
codes.description: Sold directly by the insurer to the customer.

codes.label: Broker
codes.description: Placed by an intermediary acting for the customer.

codes.label: Aggregator
codes.description: Price-comparison platform distribution.

codes.label: Coverholder
codes.description: Bound under delegated authority.

codes.label: Machine Agent

code_sets.name: document_type
code_sets.title: Document Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of unstructured content the model governs. Documents carry extracted text so LLM tools can search and cite them under the same governance as structured data.

codes.label: Policy Wording
codes.description: The contractual wording of a product, including exclusions and conditions.

codes.label: Schedule
codes.description: The policy schedule issued to the policyholder.

codes.label: Claim Evidence
codes.description: Evidence supporting a claim - reports, photographs, invoices.

codes.label: Survey Report
codes.description: Risk survey or loss adjuster report.

codes.label: MRC Slip
codes.description: Market Reform Contract slip for placed reinsurance business.

code_sets.name: dsr_status
code_sets.title: Data Subject Request Status
code_sets.description: Handling status of a data subject request against the statutory clock.

codes.label: Received
codes.description: Logged; statutory response window running.

codes.label: In Progress
codes.description: Being fulfilled.

codes.label: Completed
codes.description: Fulfilled and evidenced.

codes.label: Refused
codes.description: Refused with grounds (e.g. legal obligation to retain).

code_sets.name: dsr_type
code_sets.title: Data Subject Request Type
code_sets.description: GDPR data subject request kinds.

codes.label: Access (DSAR)
codes.description: Right of access to personal data held.

codes.label: Erasure
codes.description: Right to erasure, applied per the model's erasure design.

codes.label: Rectification
codes.description: Correction of inaccurate personal data.

codes.label: Portability
codes.description: Machine-readable export of provided data.

code_sets.name: endorsement_type
code_sets.title: Endorsement Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of mid-term change to a policy. The premium effect of an endorsement is always booked as premium transactions; the endorsement records the contractual change itself.

codes.label: Mid-term Adjustment
codes.description: General adjustment to terms during the policy period.

codes.label: Coverage Change
codes.description: Cover added, removed or amended.

codes.label: Sum Insured Change
codes.description: Declared values increased or decreased.

codes.label: Extension
codes.description: Cover period extended beyond the original expiry.

codes.label: Cancellation
codes.description: Policy terminated before natural expiry.

code_sets.name: expense_type
code_sets.title: Expense Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of operating expense allocated to lines of business - the missing half of the combined ratio.

codes.label: Acquisition Expense
codes.description: Costs of acquiring business other than commission.

codes.label: Operating Expense
codes.description: General administration allocated to the line.

codes.label: Claims Handling Expense
codes.description: Unallocated claims handling cost (ULAE).

code_sets.name: fraud_signal_type
code_sets.title: Fraud Signal Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of fraud indicator on a claim. Signals inform investigation; they never auto-decide.

codes.label: Late Reporting
codes.description: Unusual delay between loss and notification.

codes.label: Prior Claims Pattern
codes.description: Elevated recent claims frequency for the party.

codes.label: Velocity
codes.description: Multiple claims or policies opened in a short window.

codes.label: Document Inconsistency
codes.description: Evidence contradicts the reported circumstances.

codes.label: Network Link
codes.description: Link to parties or addresses seen in confirmed fraud.

code_sets.name: insured_object_type
code_sets.title: Insured Object Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of object or exposure a policy can insure. Extend with new codes as new lines of business are written (vessels, livestock, cyber estates...).

codes.label: Building
codes.description: A building or fixed structure at a defined location.

codes.label: Vehicle
codes.description: A road vehicle.

codes.label: Cargo Shipment
codes.description: A defined consignment of goods in transit.

codes.label: Liability Exposure
codes.description: An abstract exposure unit for liability covers, such as a set of business operations at a location.

code_sets.name: investment_transaction_type
code_sets.title: Investment Transaction Type
code_sets.description: Movements on investment holdings. Income and gains flow to the income statement; purchases and sales move the balance sheet.

codes.label: Purchase
codes.description: Acquisition of a holding; positive cost.

codes.label: Sale
codes.description: Disposal of a holding; proceeds.

codes.label: Coupon / Interest
codes.description: Interest income received.

codes.label: Dividend
codes.description: Dividend income received.

codes.label: Fair Value Movement
codes.description: Unrealised revaluation to market value.

code_sets.name: legal_entity_type
code_sets.title: Legal Entity Type
code_sets.description: The role a legal entity plays in the group's reporting structure. The group holding consolidates its subsidiaries; each subsidiary reports solo.

codes.label: Group Holding Company
codes.description: The top consolidating entity; reports at group level only.

codes.label: Insurance Subsidiary
codes.description: A regulated carrier reporting solo and consolidated into the group.

codes.label: Reinsurance Subsidiary
codes.description: A regulated reinsurer reporting solo and consolidated into the group.

codes.label: Service Company
codes.description: A non-regulated intra-group service or holding entity.

code_sets.name: line_of_business
code_sets.title: Line of Business
code_sets.description: Classes of insurance business written by the group, aligned to ACORD LOBCd vocabulary. Extend by adding codes; never repurpose an existing code.

codes.label: Commercial Property
codes.description: Direct insurance of commercial buildings, contents and consequent business interruption.

codes.label: Motor
codes.description: Direct motor insurance, own damage and third-party liability.

codes.label: General Liability
codes.description: Direct third-party liability other than motor, including public and products liability.

codes.label: Marine Cargo
codes.description: Direct insurance of goods in transit by sea, air or land.

codes.label: Property Treaty Reinsurance
codes.description: Treaty reinsurance of property business, assumed or ceded; the direction is determined by the party roles on the contract, not by this code.

codes.label: Term Life
codes.description: Individual term life protection.

codes.label: Credit Life
codes.description: Life cover written against outstanding credit balances.

codes.label: Group Protection
codes.description: Employer-sponsored group life and disability protection.

codes.label: Annuity
codes.description: Annuities in payment or deferment.

code_sets.name: loss_basis
code_sets.title: Loss Basis
code_sets.description: Whether an event loss figure is modelled or reported. Day-one catastrophe numbers are modelled (event footprint against in-force exposure); cedant reports firm up over the following weeks — the basis keeps the two honest.

codes.label: Modelled
codes.description: Estimated from an event footprint applied to in-force exposure.

codes.label: Reported
codes.description: Reported by the cedant or claims process.

code_sets.name: measurement_model
code_sets.title: IFRS 17 Measurement Model
code_sets.description: The IFRS 17 measurement model applied to a group of contracts.

codes.label: General Measurement Model
codes.description: Building block approach; the default model.

codes.label: Premium Allocation Approach
codes.description: Simplified model for short-duration contracts.

codes.label: Variable Fee Approach
codes.description: For contracts with direct participation features.

code_sets.name: party_role_type
code_sets.title: Party Role Type
code_sets.description: The roles a party can play in the business. This code set is the model's number-one extension point: a new kind of counterparty is a new code here, not a new table.

standards.acord: Party role patterns of the ACORD Information Model

codes.label: Policyholder
codes.description: The party that entered into the policy contract and owes the premium.

codes.label: Insured
codes.description: A party whose interest is covered by the policy; often, but not always, the policyholder.

codes.label: Broker
codes.description: An intermediary placing the business on behalf of the policyholder.

codes.label: Claimant
codes.description: The party claiming under a policy; may be a third party.

codes.label: Cedant
codes.description: The insurer ceding risk under a reinsurance contract.

codes.label: Reinsurer
codes.description: The party assuming risk under a reinsurance contract.

codes.label: Coverholder
codes.description: A party authorised to bind business on the insurer's behalf under a delegated authority.

codes.label: Buyer Agent
codes.description: A machine agent requesting and negotiating cover on behalf of the buyer.

code_sets.name: party_type
code_sets.title: Party Type
code_sets.description: Fundamental legal nature of a party. Everything else about a party's place in the business is a role, never a type.

codes.label: Person
codes.description: A natural person.

codes.label: Organisation
codes.description: A legal entity - company, partnership, public body or association.

codes.label: Machine Agent
codes.description: An autonomous software agent acting on behalf of a person or organisation - a first-class counterparty with its own identity and audited decisions.

code_sets.name: period_status
code_sets.title: Accounting Period Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle of an accounting period; postings are only allowed while OPEN.

codes.label: Open
codes.description: Postings permitted.

codes.label: Closed
codes.description: Soft-closed; reopenable by finance with control.

codes.label: Locked
codes.description: Hard-locked after reporting; no further postings.

code_sets.name: policy_status
code_sets.title: Policy Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle status of a policy contract. Status reflects the contract as a whole; coverage-level suspension is modelled on the coverage entity.

codes.label: Quoted
codes.description: Terms offered to the prospective policyholder; no cover yet in force.

codes.label: Bound
codes.description: Cover agreed and legally binding but inception date not yet reached.

codes.label: In Force
codes.description: Cover currently active; today is within the cover period.

codes.label: Expired
codes.description: Cover period ended at its natural expiry date.

codes.label: Cancelled
codes.description: Cover terminated before natural expiry by either party; return premium may exist as premium transactions.

codes.label: Lapsed
codes.description: Cover terminated for non-payment of premium.

code_sets.name: premium_transaction_type
code_sets.title: Premium Transaction Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of premium movement. Premium is always modelled as signed transactions; balances such as gross written premium are derived by summation, never overwritten.

codes.label: Written Premium
codes.description: Premium written on binding or renewal of cover; positive amount.

codes.label: Adjustment Premium
codes.description: Mid-term or declaration-based premium adjustment; signed amount.

codes.label: Return Premium
codes.description: Premium returned to the policyholder, typically on cancellation; negative amount.

code_sets.name: product_status
code_sets.title: Product Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle status of an insurance product.

codes.label: Pilot
codes.description: Limited distribution while the proposition is proven.

codes.label: Active
codes.description: Open for new business.

codes.label: Closed to New Business
codes.description: In-force book continues; no new sales.

codes.label: Withdrawn
codes.description: Fully withdrawn.

code_sets.name: quote_status
code_sets.title: Quote Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle status of a quotation. A quote that converts is linked to the resulting policy; premium only ever arises on the policy, never the quote.

codes.label: Open
codes.description: Quotation requested and being worked.

codes.label: Offered
codes.description: Terms offered to the prospective policyholder.

codes.label: Converted
codes.description: Offer accepted; a policy has been issued from this quote.

codes.label: Declined by Insurer
codes.description: The insurer declined to offer terms.

codes.label: Rejected by Customer
codes.description: Terms offered but not taken up.

codes.label: Expired
codes.description: Offer lapsed unanswered at its validity date.

code_sets.name: receivable_transaction_type
code_sets.title: Receivable Transaction Type
code_sets.description: Premium billing movements. Outstanding debt is the signed sum - invoices positive, cash negative - never a stored balance.

codes.description: Premium invoiced to the payer; positive.

codes.label: Cash Receipt
codes.description: Premium cash received; negative.

codes.label: Write-off
codes.description: Irrecoverable balance written off; negative.

codes.label: Refund
codes.description: Premium refunded to the payer; positive.

code_sets.name: reporting_level
code_sets.title: Reporting Level
code_sets.description: Whether a figure is a single entity's own return (solo) or the consolidated group position. Solvency II and statutory accounts both require both.

codes.label: Solo
codes.description: A single legal entity's own reporting.

codes.label: Group
codes.description: Consolidated across the group, after eliminations.

code_sets.name: reporting_regime
code_sets.title: Reporting Regime
code_sets.description: The reporting framework a figure is prepared under. One valuation or statement figure means different things under different regimes; the regime is never assumed.

codes.label: Solvency II

codes.label: IFRS 17
codes.description: IFRS 17 insurance contracts accounting standard.

codes.label: Statutory / Local GAAP

codes.label: Management
codes.description: Internal management-reporting basis.

codes.label: Reinsurance (Core)

codes.label: Life Administration (Core)

code_sets.name: statement_type
code_sets.title: Financial Statement Type
code_sets.description: The primary financial statement a line belongs to.

codes.label: Balance Sheet
codes.description: Statement of financial position.

codes.label: Income Statement
codes.description: Statement of profit or loss.

codes.label: Cash Flow Statement
codes.description: Statement of cash flows.

code_sets.name: submission_status
code_sets.title: Submission Status
code_sets.description: Lifecycle of a reinsurance submission from receipt to bind or decline.

codes.label: Received
codes.description: Submission received and awaiting triage.

codes.label: In Review
codes.description: Under triage, pricing and accumulation assessment.

codes.label: Quoted
codes.description: Terms quoted back to the cedant or broker.

codes.label: Bound
codes.description: Accepted and bound; a treaty exists for this submission.

codes.label: Declined
codes.description: Declined by the reinsurer.

codes.label: Withdrawn

code_sets.name: tax_type
code_sets.title: Tax Type
code_sets.description: Kinds of tax the group accounts for.

codes.label: Insurance Premium Tax
codes.description: Premium tax collected on policies and remitted to the authority.

codes.label: Corporation Tax
codes.description: Tax on taxable profits.

codes.label: Deferred Tax
codes.description: Deferred tax on timing differences.

code_sets.name: treaty_type
code_sets.title: Treaty Type
code_sets.description: Forms of treaty reinsurance. Direction (assumed or ceded) is determined by the cedant and reinsurer party roles on the treaty, not by this code.

codes.label: Quota Share
codes.description: Proportional treaty ceding a fixed share of every risk in scope.

codes.label: Surplus
codes.description: Proportional treaty ceding the portion of each risk above the cedant's retained line.

codes.label: Excess of Loss (Per Risk)
codes.description: Non-proportional cover for individual risk losses above an attachment point.

codes.label: Excess of Loss (Catastrophe)
codes.description: Non-proportional cover for accumulated losses from a single catastrophe event.

code_sets.name: underwriting_decision_type
code_sets.title: Underwriting Decision
code_sets.description: Outcome of an underwriting decision. Every decision records who or what decided and against which appetite rule - human and machine decisions are audited identically.

codes.label: Accept
codes.description: Risk accepted at the quoted terms.

codes.label: Refer
codes.description: Referred to a human underwriter; outside automatic authority.

codes.label: Decline
codes.description: Risk declined.

code_sets.name: valuation_measure
code_sets.title: Valuation Measure
code_sets.description: Financial measures produced by valuation processes across regimes. One code set serves life and non-life, Solvency II and IFRS 17: a measure is a defined quantity, and new regimes add codes, not tables.

codes.description: Present value of expected future cash flows, Solvency II best estimate.

codes.label: Risk Margin

codes.label: Technical Provision

codes.label: Case Reserves (Total)
