attributes.description: System of record the submission originates from.

entities.name: treaty
entities.title: Treaty
entities.description: A treaty reinsurance contract under which risks are ceded to or assumed from reinsurers. Cedant and reinsurer are party roles on the treaty; which business it covers is expressed through cessions.
entities.grain: One row per treaty contract per underwriting year.

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Stable identifier for the treaty, owned by the data layer.

attributes.name: treaty_reference
attributes.description: Treaty reference as agreed between the parties.

attributes.name: treaty_type_code
attributes.description: Form of the treaty.

attributes.name: line_of_business_code
attributes.description: Class of business the treaty covers.

attributes.name: underwriting_year
attributes.description: Underwriting year of account of the treaty.

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Date treaty cover begins (inclusive).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date treaty cover ends (inclusive). Must be on or after inception_date.

attributes.name: cession_rate
attributes.description: Contractual ceded share for proportional treaties, as a fraction between 0 and 1; empty for non-proportional forms.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Currency of the treaty.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: System of record the treaty originates from.

quality.name: cover_period_valid
quality.description: Treaty cover cannot end before it begins.

entities.name: treaty_layer
entities.title: Treaty Layer
entities.description: A layer of a treaty programme: limit and attachment for non-proportional forms, with reinstatement terms where they apply. Proportional treaties typically have a single layer carrying the ceded share economics on the treaty itself.
entities.grain: One row per layer per treaty.

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the layer.

attributes.name: treaty_id
attributes.description: Treaty the layer belongs to.

attributes.name: layer_number
attributes.description: Position of the layer in the programme, 1 = lowest attachment.

attributes.name: limit_amount
attributes.description: Limit of the layer, in the treaty currency.

attributes.name: attachment_amount
attributes.description: Attachment point of the layer; empty for proportional forms.

attributes.name: reinstatement_count
attributes.description: Number of reinstatements available, where applicable.

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_rate
attributes.description: Reinstatement premium as a fraction of the layer premium.

views.name: cession_bordereau_line
views.title: Cession Bordereau Line (outbound)
views.description: The outbound cession bordereau, derived live from the canonical model: one line per policy premium movement ceded to a treaty, with the ceded amount computed from the contractual ceded share. This view - together with the data_dictionary - IS the bordereau: it is shared as a governed table, never exported to a spreadsheet.
views.grain: One row per ceded premium movement per policy per treaty.
views.sql:
SELECT
  tr.treaty_reference,
  DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', pt.transaction_date) AS reporting_month,
  p.policy_number,
  ins.name AS insured_name,
  p.line_of_business_code,
  p.inception_date,
  p.expiry_date,
  pt.currency_code,
  pt.amount AS gross_premium,
  ces.ceded_share,
  CAST(ROUND(pt.amount * ces.ceded_share, 2) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS ceded_premium
FROM {reinsurance.cession} ces
JOIN {policy.policy} p ON p.policy_id = ces.policy_id
JOIN {reinsurance.treaty} tr ON tr.treaty_id = ces.treaty_id
JOIN {policy.premium_transaction} pt ON pt.policy_id = p.policy_id
LEFT JOIN {party.party_role} pr
  ON pr.policy_id = p.policy_id AND pr.party_role_type_code = 'INSURED'
LEFT JOIN {party.party} ins ON ins.party_id = pr.party_id

views.name: financial_transaction
views.title: Financial Transaction (unified)
views.description: Unified view of all financial movements - premium and claim transactions - with their policy context, so portfolio metrics that span premium and claims (such as loss ratio) can be defined over a single source. Amounts are in original transaction currency.
views.grain: One row per premium or claim transaction.
views.sql:
SELECT
  p.policy_id,
  p.underwriting_year,
  p.line_of_business_code,
  pt.currency_code,
  pt.transaction_date,
  'PREMIUM' AS transaction_kind,
  pt.premium_transaction_type_code AS transaction_type_code,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS claim_id,
  CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS cause_of_loss_code,
  pt.amount
FROM {policy.premium_transaction} pt
JOIN {policy.policy} p ON p.policy_id = pt.policy_id
UNION ALL
SELECT
  p.policy_id,
  p.underwriting_year,
  p.line_of_business_code,
  ct.currency_code,
  ct.transaction_date,
  'CLAIM' AS transaction_kind,
  ct.claim_transaction_type_code AS transaction_type_code,
  c.claim_id,
  c.cause_of_loss_code,
  ct.amount
FROM {claim.claim_transaction} ct
JOIN {claim.claim} c ON c.claim_id = ct.claim_id
JOIN {policy.policy} p ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id

views.name: premium_earning
views.title: Premium Earning
views.description: Written, earned-to-date and unearned premium per policy, on a straight-line daily earning basis over the cover period. Honest limits: cancellations earn to their natural period in this version, and earning patterns other than straight-line are a later addition.
views.grain: One row per policy per currency with premium activity.
views.sql:
SELECT
  p.policy_id,
  p.line_of_business_code,
  p.underwriting_year,
  pt.currency_code,
  CAST(SUM(pt.amount) AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS written_premium,
  CAST(SUM(pt.amount * LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(0.0,
      (datediff(LEAST(current_date(), p.expiry_date), p.inception_date) + 1) / 365.0)))
    AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS earned_premium,
  CAST(SUM(pt.amount) - SUM(pt.amount * LEAST(1.0, GREATEST(0.0,
      (datediff(LEAST(current_date(), p.expiry_date), p.inception_date) + 1) / 365.0)))
    AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS unearned_premium
FROM {policy.premium_transaction} pt
JOIN {policy.policy} p ON p.policy_id = pt.policy_id
GROUP BY p.policy_id, p.line_of_business_code, p.underwriting_year, pt.currency_code

views.name: underwriting_performance
views.title: Underwriting Performance Components
views.description: Earned premium, incurred claims and allocated expenses as one component stream, so ratio metrics (loss, expense, combined) are defined over a single source. Expenses are allocated at line level, not underwriting year.
views.grain: One row per component per line of business (per underwriting year where applicable) per currency.
views.sql:
SELECT line_of_business_code, underwriting_year, currency_code,
       'EARNED' AS component, earned_premium AS amount
FROM {semantics.premium_earning}
UNION ALL
SELECT p.line_of_business_code, p.underwriting_year, ct.currency_code,
       'INCURRED' AS component, ct.amount
FROM {claim.claim_transaction} ct
JOIN {claim.claim} c ON c.claim_id = ct.claim_id
JOIN {policy.policy} p ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id
UNION ALL
SELECT line_of_business_code, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), currency_code,
       'EXPENSE' AS component, amount
FROM {finance.expense_transaction}

metric_views.name: cession_metrics
metric_views.title: Cession Metrics
metric_views.description: Outward reinsurance KPIs over the cession bordereau: gross and ceded premium by treaty and period. Amounts are in original transaction currency; group by or filter on currency_code before summing money. Query measures with MEASURE(name).

dimensions.name: treaty_reference
dimensions.description: Treaty the premium is ceded to.

dimensions.name: reporting_month
dimensions.description: Bordereau reporting month.

dimensions.name: line_of_business
dimensions.description: Line of business as its business label, e.g. 'Commercial Property'. Filter with labels; use line_of_business_code for codes.

dimensions.name: line_of_business_code
dimensions.description: Line of business as its code, e.g. COMMERCIAL_PROPERTY.

dimensions.name: currency_code
dimensions.description: Original currency of the amounts. Group by this before summing money.

measures.name: gross_premium
measures.expr: SUM(gross_premium)
measures.description: Gross premium on the ceded policies, in original currency.

measures.name: ceded_premium
measures.expr: SUM(ceded_premium)
measures.description: Premium ceded to reinsurers, in original currency.

measures.name: average_ceded_share
measures.expr: SUM(ceded_premium) / NULLIF(SUM(gross_premium), 0)
measures.description: Effective ceded share - ceded premium over gross premium.

measures.name: ceded_policy_count
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT policy_number)
measures.description: Number of distinct policies with ceded premium.

metric_views.name: financial_position
metric_views.title: Financial Position
metric_views.description: Financial-statement line items assembled from the ledger via the statement mapping - the balance sheet and income statement in business language, by legal entity and regime. Query MEASURE(line_amount) grouped by statement and line; constrain currency_code and reporting_regime.

dimensions.name: statement_type
dimensions.description: Balance sheet, income statement or cash flow.

dimensions.name: reporting_regime
dimensions.description: Presentation regime; constrain this.

dimensions.name: line_label
dimensions.description: The statement line item, e.g. 'Net earned premium'.

dimensions.name: legal_entity_id
dimensions.description: Posting entity - filter for a solo statement.

dimensions.name: currency_code
dimensions.description: Currency. Always constrain.

measures.name: line_amount
measures.expr: SUM(amount * statement_line.sign)
measures.description: The statement line value, sign-adjusted for presentation.

metric_views.name: investment_metrics
metric_views.title: Investment Metrics
metric_views.description: The asset side: market value, book cost, unrealised gain and investment income by asset class and legal entity. Query with MEASURE(); constrain currency_code.

dimensions.name: asset_class
dimensions.description: Asset class as its business label.

dimensions.name: asset_class_code
dimensions.description: Asset class code.

dimensions.name: legal_entity_id
dimensions.description: Owning legal entity.

dimensions.name: currency_code
dimensions.description: Currency. Always constrain.

measures.name: market_value
measures.expr: SUM(market_value)
measures.description: Total market value of holdings.

measures.name: book_cost
measures.expr: SUM(book_cost)
measures.description: Total acquisition cost of holdings.

measures.name: unrealised_gain
measures.expr: SUM(market_value) - SUM(book_cost)
measures.description: Market value less book cost.

measures.name: holding_count
measures.expr: COUNT(*)
measures.description: Number of holdings.

metric_views.name: performance_metrics
metric_views.title: Performance Metrics
metric_views.description: The underwriting result: earned premium, incurred claims, expenses and the loss / expense / combined ratios - each defined once. Earning is straight-line daily; expenses are line-level, so combined ratio is meaningful per line and currency (not per underwriting year). Always constrain currency_code. Query measures with MEASURE(name).

dimensions.name: line_of_business
dimensions.description: Line of business as its business label, e.g. 'Commercial Property'. Filter with labels; use line_of_business_code for codes.

dimensions.name: line_of_business_code
dimensions.description: Line of business as its code, e.g. COMMERCIAL_PROPERTY.

dimensions.name: currency_code
dimensions.description: Original currency. Always constrain before ratios or sums.

measures.name: earned_premium
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN component = 'EARNED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Premium earned to date, straight-line daily basis.

measures.name: claims_incurred
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN component = 'INCURRED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Paid plus outstanding net of recoveries.

measures.name: expenses
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN component = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Operating, acquisition and claims-handling expenses allocated to the line.

measures.name: loss_ratio_earned
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN component = 'INCURRED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN component = 'EARNED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
measures.description: Claims incurred over earned premium.

measures.name: expense_ratio
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN component = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN component = 'EARNED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
measures.description: Expenses over earned premium.

measures.name: combined_ratio
measures.expr: (SUM(CASE WHEN component = 'INCURRED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN component = 'EXPENSE' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN component = 'EARNED' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
measures.description: Loss ratio plus expense ratio; below 1.0 is an underwriting profit.

metric_views.name: submission_metrics
metric_views.title: Submission Metrics
metric_views.description: Reinsurance submission funnel KPIs: volumes and requested capacity by status, form and year. Amounts are in original submission currency; group by or filter on currency_code before summing money. Query measures with MEASURE(name).

dimensions.name: underwriting_year
dimensions.description: Underwriting year the cover would attach to.

dimensions.name: submission_status
dimensions.description: Funnel status as its business label.

dimensions.name: treaty_type_code
dimensions.description: Form of treaty requested.

dimensions.name: line_of_business
dimensions.description: Line of business as its business label, e.g. 'Commercial Property'. Filter with labels; use line_of_business_code for codes.

dimensions.name: line_of_business_code
dimensions.description: Line of business as its code, e.g. COMMERCIAL_PROPERTY.

dimensions.name: currency_code
dimensions.description: Original currency of requested terms. Group by this before summing money.

measures.name: submission_count
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT submission_id)
measures.description: Number of submissions.

measures.name: bound_count
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN submission_status_code = 'BOUND' THEN submission_id END)
measures.description: Submissions bound into treaties.

measures.name: bind_ratio
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN submission_status_code = 'BOUND' THEN submission_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT submission_id), 0)
measures.description: Bound submissions over all submissions.

measures.name: requested_limit_total
measures.expr: SUM(requested_limit)
measures.description: Total limit requested, in original currency.

metric_views.name: trial_balance
metric_views.title: Trial Balance
metric_views.description: The trial balance: net movement by ledger account, entity and period, from the journal lines. Because every journal balances, the total across all accounts nets to zero - the controller's first check. Query with MEASURE(net_movement); always constrain currency_code.

dimensions.name: account_number
dimensions.description: Ledger account number.

dimensions.name: account_name
dimensions.description: Ledger account name.

dimensions.name: account_type
dimensions.description: Asset, liability, equity, income or expense.

dimensions.name: statement_type
dimensions.description: Which primary statement the account belongs to.

dimensions.name: legal_entity_id
dimensions.description: The posting legal entity - filter for solo, omit for all entities.

dimensions.name: currency_code
dimensions.description: Currency. Always constrain before summing.

measures.name: net_movement
measures.expr: SUM(amount)
measures.description: Net signed movement (debits positive, credits negative). Summed across all accounts this is zero - the balancing check.

measures.name: total_debits
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Sum of debit lines.

measures.name: total_credits
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN -amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Sum of credit lines.

metric_views.name: underwriting_metrics
metric_views.title: Underwriting Metrics
metric_views.description: Certified underwriting KPIs - premium, claims development and loss ratio - defined once over the canonical model. Measures are in original transaction currency: always group by or filter on currency_code before summing money. Query measures with MEASURE(name).

dimensions.name: underwriting_year
dimensions.description: Underwriting year of account of the underlying policy.

dimensions.name: line_of_business
dimensions.description: Line of business as its business label, e.g. 'Commercial Property'. Filter this dimension with labels; use line_of_business_code for codes.

dimensions.name: line_of_business_code
dimensions.description: Line of business as its code, e.g. COMMERCIAL_PROPERTY.

dimensions.name: currency_code
dimensions.description: Original currency of the transaction. Group by this before summing money.

dimensions.name: transaction_month
dimensions.description: Calendar month the movement was booked in.

dimensions.name: cause_of_loss_code
dimensions.description: Cause of loss for claim movements; empty for premium movements.

measures.name: gross_written_premium
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_kind = 'PREMIUM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Sum of all premium movements (written, adjustments, returns) - the book's gross written premium in original currency.

measures.name: claims_paid
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type_code IN ('INDEMNITY_PAYMENT', 'EXPENSE_PAYMENT') THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Indemnity plus allocated expense paid, gross of recoveries.

measures.name: recoveries
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type_code = 'RECOVERY' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Subrogation, salvage and contribution recoveries (negative amounts).

measures.name: outstanding_reserve
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type_code = 'CASE_RESERVE_MOVEMENT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Current case reserves - the sum of all signed reserve movements.

measures.name: claims_incurred
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_kind = 'CLAIM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
measures.description: Paid plus outstanding net of recoveries - total claims incurred.

measures.name: loss_ratio
measures.expr: SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_kind = 'CLAIM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_kind = 'PREMIUM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0)
measures.description: Claims incurred divided by gross written premium. Meaningful within a single currency; not premium-earned-adjusted in this version.

measures.name: policy_count
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN transaction_kind = 'PREMIUM' THEN policy_id END)
measures.description: Number of distinct policies with premium activity.

measures.name: claim_count
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT claim_id)
measures.description: Number of distinct claims with financial activity.

metric_views.name: valuation_metrics
metric_views.title: Valuation Metrics
metric_views.description: Published valuation figures (BEL, technical provisions, SCR, CSM...) by run, measure and line of business - one semantic surface across life and non-life, Solvency II and IFRS 17. Amounts are in original currency; group by or filter on currency_code and valuation_measure_code before summing. Query measures with MEASURE(name).

dimensions.name: valuation_date
dimensions.description: Valuation date of the producing run.

dimensions.name: valuation_measure_code
dimensions.description: Which defined measure the figure is (BEL, SCR, CSM...). Always constrain this before summing.

dimensions.name: line_of_business
dimensions.description: Line of business as its business label, e.g. 'Term Life'. Filter this dimension with labels; use line_of_business_code for codes.

dimensions.name: line_of_business_code
dimensions.description: Line of business as its code, e.g. TERM_LIFE.

dimensions.name: cohort
dimensions.description: Optional sub-division of the figure.

dimensions.name: currency_code
dimensions.description: Original currency. Group by this before summing money.

measures.name: total_amount
measures.expr: SUM(amount)
measures.description: Sum of the figures - only meaningful within one measure and one currency.

measures.name: run_count
measures.expr: COUNT(DISTINCT valuation_run_id)
measures.description: Number of distinct producing runs represented.

functions.name: fn_claim_status
functions.description: One-line status of a claim - handling status, cause and loss date.

returns.description: status | cause | loss date, or NULL when unknown.

functions.sql:
(SELECT max(concat(claim_status_code, ' | ', cause_of_loss_code,
                   ' | loss date ', cast(loss_date AS STRING)))
 FROM {claim.claim} WHERE claim_number = in_claim_number)

functions.name: fn_outstanding_reserve
functions.description: The current outstanding case reserve on a claim, derived live as the sum of signed reserve movements - never a stored balance.

returns.description: Outstanding reserve in the claim currency; 0 when fully released.

functions.sql:
(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ct.amount), 0)
 FROM {claim.claim_transaction} ct
 JOIN {claim.claim} c ON c.claim_id = ct.claim_id
 WHERE c.claim_number = in_claim_number
   AND ct.claim_transaction_type_code = 'CASE_RESERVE_MOVEMENT')

functions.name: fn_csm_closing
functions.description: The closing contractual service margin for a group of contracts, derived live as the signed sum of its CSM roll-forward movements - never a stored balance. The IFRS 17 reproducibility story in one call.

returns.description: Closing CSM in the group currency.

functions.name: fn_trial_balance_check
functions.description: The controller's first question, answered: does the ledger balance for a legal entity? Returns the net of all journal-line amounts - zero means debits equal credits.

returns.description: Net of all posting lines for the entity; 0.00 when the ledger balances.

functions.sql:
(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.amount), 0)
 FROM {finance.journal_line} jl
 JOIN {finance.journal} j ON j.journal_id = jl.journal_id
 WHERE j.legal_entity_id = in_legal_entity_id)

functions.name: fn_policy_snapshot
functions.description: One-line snapshot of a policy - line, status, cover period, year, currency.

returns.description: lob | status | period | underwriting year | currency, or NULL when unknown.

functions.sql:
(SELECT max(concat(line_of_business_code, ' | ', policy_status_code, ' | ',
                   cast(inception_date AS STRING), ' to ', cast(expiry_date AS STRING),
                   ' | uwy ', cast(underwriting_year AS STRING), ' | ', currency_code))
 FROM {policy.policy} WHERE policy_number = in_policy_number)

functions.name: fn_appetite_check
functions.description: Checks a prospective risk against the live appetite rules and returns the effect (WITHIN_APPETITE, REFER or OUT_OF_APPETITE) with the matching rule's business description. The same rules humans read; the tool agents call before quoting.

inputs.name: in_lob
inputs.description: Line of business code, e.g. COMMERCIAL_PROPERTY.

inputs.name: in_country
inputs.description: Country code of the risk, e.g. GB.

inputs.name: in_sum_insured
inputs.description: Proposed sum insured in the product currency.

returns.description: effect | rule description, or a REFER fallback when no rule matches.

functions.sql:
COALESCE(
  (SELECT min_by(concat(appetite_effect_code, ' | ', description), rule_order)
   FROM {product.appetite_rule}
   WHERE line_of_business_code = in_lob
     AND (country_code IS NULL OR country_code = in_country)
     AND (max_sum_insured IS NULL OR in_sum_insured <= max_sum_insured)
     AND effective_from <= current_date()
     AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to >= current_date())),
  'REFER | no matching appetite rule - refer to underwriting')

functions.name: fn_indicative_quote
functions.description: Returns an indicative gross premium for an active product and sum insured, from the product's declared base rate. Indicative only - binding terms always pass through an underwriting decision.

inputs.name: in_sum_insured
inputs.description: Proposed sum insured in the product currency.

returns.description: Indicative gross premium; NULL when the product is unknown or inactive.

functions.sql:
round((SELECT max(base_rate)
       FROM {product.product}
       WHERE product_code = in_product_code
         AND product_status_code = 'ACTIVE') * in_sum_insured, 2)

functions.name: fn_define
functions.description: Looks a business term up in the data dictionary - the model explaining itself to humans and agents alike.

inputs.name: in_term
inputs.description: An entity or attribute name, e.g. loss_ratio or claim.

returns.description: Up to three matching definitions, '||'-separated; NULL when unknown.

functions.sql:
(SELECT array_join(slice(sort_array(collect_list(
          concat(entity_name, '.', attribute_name, ': ', definition))), 1, 3), ' || ')
 FROM {reference.data_dictionary}
 WHERE lower(attribute_name) = lower(in_term) OR lower(entity_name) = lower(in_term))

functions.name: fn_cession_trace
functions.description: Which treaties a policy is ceded to, and at what shares.

returns.description: Semicolon-separated 'treaty @ share' list; NULL when nothing is ceded.

functions.sql:
(SELECT array_join(sort_array(collect_list(
          concat(t.treaty_reference, ' @ ', cast(ces.ceded_share AS STRING)))), '; ')
 FROM {reinsurance.cession} ces
 JOIN {policy.policy} p ON p.policy_id = ces.policy_id
 JOIN {reinsurance.treaty} t ON t.treaty_id = ces.treaty_id
 WHERE p.policy_number = in_policy_number)
